name: Grocery Assistant Evaluation
description: Evaluates the main grocery retail assistant agent across SOP lookup, brand guidelines, analytics routing, image generation, and general capabilities.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What are the closing procedures for frontline associates?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After receiving the SOP information, ask about any safety checks that need to be performed during closing. Then ask who is responsible for signing off on the closing checklist.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What are our brand color guidelines?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After getting the color information, ask about the typography standards. Then ask about the tone of voice guidelines for marketing materials.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: What are the top 5 products by revenue?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After seeing the results, ask which store has the highest total sales. Then ask about how customers are distributed across loyalty tiers.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Generate a product image for Nano Banana Pro
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to apply our brand guidelines to the image. Then ask for a version with a white background suitable for the website.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hello, what can you help me with?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask about each capability one by one. Start with SOPs, then analytics, then image generation. Confirm the agent can handle all four areas.
